newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end up but investors wary on yen move.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end up but investors wary on yen move.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended slightly higher on Thursday after drifting in negative and positive territory during the session, brokers said.
They said recent sharp fluctuations of the yen kept investors hugging the sidelines.
The Nikkei 225 average finished 35.41 points or 0.18 percent higher at 19,877.39. Nikkei June futures rose 30 points to 19,850.

"The yen is showing signs of stabilising but exporters are still depressed by uncertainty and the buying momentum of domestic-demand driven shares, which had been bought instead, is slowing," said Haruo Nakaharu, Toyo Securities strategist.
